## Offer
- Free homepage preview within 5 days of a 15-minute call. $0 upfront. Pay only if you love it.
- Starter Site (1–3 pages): $499 one-time, incl. 12 months hosting & care, then $29/month.
- Pro Site (4–10 pages incl. up to 3 city pages, admin panel, 1 month of SEO free): $199/month with a 12-month minimum (own it early by paying the difference to $1,499) or $1,499 one-time.
- Roofing SEO: Local SEO [PRICE_SEO_LOCAL]/month (1 city), SEO Pro [PRICE_SEO_PRO]/month (2–3 cities). 6 months → 3 extra landing pages free.
- Google Ads for roofers: $399 setup + 10% of ad spend; minimum ad budget $2,000/month paid directly to Google; weekly reports.
- Clients own their domain, Google Business Profile and ad accounts. No ranking guarantees.
